name: duopore-public-product-snapshot-diff
description: See which product prices or stock counts changed between two lists.

interface.longDescription: See which product prices or stock counts changed between two lists. Share an older product list and a newer one, using the same product codes. Find added products, removed products, and changes to price or stock. Prices must use the same currency. This compares your two lists; it does not check live shop stock.
defaultPrompt: Compare these two product lists for price and stock changes.
Which products were added or removed from my new list?

positive.prompt: Use Price and Stock Changes with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"before":[{"sku":"001","price":10,"stock":5},{"sku":"002","price":8,"stock":2}],"after":[{"sku":"001","price":12,"stock":3},{"sku":"003","price":4,"stock":1}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"3 SKU changes found.","rows":[{"sku":"001","change":"changed","oldPrice":10,"newPrice":12,"priceDelta":2,"oldStock":5,"newStock":3,"stockDelta":-2},{"sku":"002","change":"removed","oldPrice":8,"newPrice":null,"priceDelta":null,"oldStock":2,"newStock":null,"stockDelta":null},{"sku":"003","change":"added","oldPrice":null,"newPrice":4,"priceDelta":null,"oldStock":null,"newStock":1,"stockDelta":null}],"warnings":["Snapshots are user-supplied; price comparison assumes one currency."]}
